summary.en: Seeking Alpha, the world's leading community for engaged investors, is hiring a Manual QA Engineer to ensure quality across its financial analysis and stock market research platform. The role offers fully remote work, career development opportunities, and is part of a team focused on actionable investment insights.
summary.lv: Seeking Alpha, pasaulē vadošā ieguldītāju kopiena, meklē manuālo QA inženieri, lai nodrošinātu kvalitāti finanšu analīzes un akciju tirgus izpētes platformā. Amats piedāvā pilnīgi attālinātu darbu un karjeras attīstības iespējas.
